Sobre a vaga

About Distillery

Distillery accelerates innovation through an unyielding approach to nearshore software development. The world’s most innovative technology teams choose Distillery to help accelerate strategic innovation, fill a pressing technology gap, and hit mission-critical deadlines. We support essential applications, mobile apps, websites, and eCommerce platforms by placing senior, strategic technical leaders and deploying fully managed technology teams that work intimately alongside our client’s in-house development teams. At Distillery we’re not here to reinvent nearshore software development, we’re on a mission to perfect it. Distillery is committed to diversity and inclusion. We actively seek to cultivate a workforce that reflects the rich tapestry of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences present in our society. Our recruitment efforts are dedicated to promoting equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other dimension of diversity

Key Skills & Experience:

● 5+ years of proven experience with NetSuite, focusing on financial modules and functionalities within a professional services environment.

● 3+ years of experience in developing workflows, saved searches, custom forms, and record types in NetSuite.

● Proficiency with SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, SuiteBundler, SuiteCloud Development

Framework, and Suitelets (both Front-End and Back-End).

● Expertise in NetSuite reporting tools (Financial Report Builder, Saved Searches, SuiteAnalytics) and data visualization tools such as T ableau.

● In-depth knowledge of NetSuite configuration, customization, and administration, including workflows, forms, fields, roles, and permissions.

● Experience with system integrations, implementations, data migration, and financial data analysis.

● NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteFoundation, SuiteAnalytics) and familiarity with T ableau and NetSuite scripting are considered an asset.

● Strong skills in business requirements analysis, technical design, coding, testing, and implementation of customizations within software environments.

● Excellent project management and business analysis skills, capable of understanding and translating financial and operational processes into system requirements.

● Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in across-functional team environment.

● Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

● Experience working in agile/kanban teams, participating in sprints, continuous delivery, code reviews, and other aspects of the modern software delivery lifecycle (SDLC).

● Participate in sprint-related meetings such as standups, grooming, retrospectives, and roadmap

replenishment.

● Advocate for flexible, domain-driven solutions that balance expediency with long-term flexibility.

Main Responsibilities:

● Design, develop, and deploy customizations, scripts, and workflows within NetSuite.

● Utilize SuiteScript, SuiteBuilder, SuiteFlow, and other NetSuite development tools to extend platform functionality.

● Integrate NetSuite with third-party systems, applications, and APIs, and maintain integration solutions to ensure data consistency and seamless workflows across systems.

● Oversee the administration and maintenance of the ERP system, ensuring data integrity, security,

user access, roles, permissions, and system performance.

● Develop ad-hoc reports to support specific business needs and decision-making, and design

comprehensive financial reports and dashboards to provide insights into the financial performance of projects, departments, and the organization.

● Provide ongoing support to end-users, including training as needed to increase user adoption and engagement with NetSuite's financial functionalities and reporting tools.

● Partner with teams to understand business requirements and illustrate ways to leverage NetSuite to meet these requirements, implementing system and reporting changes to enhance operational

efficiency and accuracy.

● Develop, document, and follow formal policies, procedures, and protocols for changes,

customization, standards, and usage.

● Provide technical leadership and guidance to project teams, ensuring best practices and standards are followed.

● Participate in sprint-related meetings such as standups, grooming, retrospectives, and roadmap

replenishment.

● Advocate for flexible, domain-driven solutions that balance expediency with long-term flexibility.

Why You'll Like Working Here

Join a global team committed to Distillery's core values: Unyielding Commitment, Relentless Pursuit, Courageous Ambition, and Authentic Connection.

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere while collaborating with a diverse, multinational team.
  • Competitive Compensation: Generous and competitive package in USD, along with a comprehensive benefits plan.
  • Flexible Hours: Create a schedule that aligns with your life and priorities.
  • Home Office Setup: Receive all the hardware and software needed to succeed from home.
  • Innovative Workplace: Collaborate with the global Top 1% of talent in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
  • Focus on Growth: Pursue professional and personal development while contributing your unique talents to a team where you can truly shine!
